name: Nahath
overview: The name Nahath appears in Scripture referring to two distinct individuals connected to different lineages. First, Nahath is identified as a son of Reuel and a descendant of Esau, noted among the chiefs in Edom (Genesis 36:13, 17; 1 Chronicles 1:37). Second, Nahath is also mentioned as a Levite, a descendant of Toah (also spelled Tohu or Tohu), who served as an overseer of the sacred offerings, highlighting a role of spiritual responsibility within Israel's worship system (1 Samuel 1:1; 1 Chronicles 6:26, 34). These references emphasize Nahath's place both in the genealogical history of God's people and in the faithful administration of temple duties.
